title: Bone of the Forgotten
summary: Ha-Jun arrives at the desolate Incheon limestone quarry, descending into the sunken subterranean ossuary catacombs to locate the Bone of the Forgotten.

panels.shot: abandoned incheon limestone quarry wide shot
panels.action: A colossal crater of jagged white limestone cliffs under heavy storm clouds; rusted cranes loom like skeletons.

panels.shot: van parked near rusted chainlink fence
panels.action: The laundry van halts beside a bent 'DANGER: SINKHOLE COLLAPSE' hazard warning sign.
Ha-Jun steps onto the chalky limestone mud, wearing a dark hooded windbreaker over his uniform.
Kuro circles above through the dense limestone mist, scanning the quarry floor.

panels.shot: gaping sinkhole rift in quarry floor
panels.action: In the lowest depression of the quarry, a 50-foot jagged chasm exhales bone-chilling white mist.
Min-Jae hands Ha-Jun a heavy military flare gun and three crimson phosphorus cartridges.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Agar niche radio signal cut ho jaye, toh red flare fire karna.

panels.action: Ha-Jun pockets the flares and smiles with quiet gratitude: 'Yahan van mein safe rehna.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar koi Hunter aaye, toh bina soche bhaag jana, samjhe?

panels.action: Ha-Jun dives over the precipice into the white mist, using mana to glide along the sheer rock face.
Ha-Jun lands in a three-point stance on cold, petrified white stone tiles 200 feet below ground.
Faint cyan phosphorescence emanates from glowing mineral deposits lining the ancient arched limestone vault.

panels.shot: ground paved with millions of petrified bones
panels.action: The entire floor is paved not with tiles, but with millions of calcified ancient demonic and human bones.

panels.shot: kuro landing on broken statue head
panels.action: Kuro alights atop the shattered stone head of a four-armed demon deity.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Welcome to the Tomb of the Million Martyrs. Yeh First Sovereign ki royal army ka burial ground hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun walks between colossal pillars carved directly from fused gigantic spinal columns.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Itni ajeeb shanti hai yahan... jaise hazaron roohein so rahi hon.

panels.shot: ring of hollow blood pulsing cold
panels.action: The obsidian ring turns ice-cold, frosting over with white rime as it detects bone marrow resonance.
The Sovereign Interface flashes with sharp bone-white runes.

dialogue.text:
[QUEST ADVANCE: BASIC SEAL - PART 2]
Locate the Sovereign's Bone.
Warning: The Eternal Guardian slumbers nearby.
Awakening Risk: Extreme.

panels.action: At the apex of a seven-tiered limestone staircase rests a crystalline ossuary altar.
Suspended above the altar: an intricate, 14-inch curved ivory bone relic engraved with glowing violet runes.
Ha-Jun ascends the final step, reaching his right hand toward the suspended bone artifact.
The entire cavern violently shudders; bone pillars rattle as dust cascades from the ceiling.

panels.shot: bones on floor swirling in vortex
panels.action: Thousands of calcified bones across the floor begin swirling into a ferocious skeletal cyclone.
Ha-Jun leaps backward four meters, landing on guard with hands up as wind lashes his coat.
Kuro takes to the air, wings flaring with violet sparks: 'Guardian jaag chuka hai!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: SKELETAL CENTURION! Apni talwar nikaalo, Ha-Jun!

panels.action: From the bone cyclone rises a colossal 15-foot Skeletal Centurion clad in ancient oxidized bronze armor.
Two blazing azure soul-flames ignite inside the Centurion's massive horned skull.
With a terrifying scrape, the giant pulls an eight-foot serrated bone broadsword from its own spinal column.
A voice like grinding boulders booms through the air, vibrating Ha-Jun's eardrums.

dialogue.speaker: centurion
dialogue.text: KAUN HAI WOH NAADAN JO SOVEREIGN KI BONE KO CHHUNE AAYA HAI?!

panels.action: Ha-Jun gazes upward at the towering juggernaut, his heart hammering against his ribs.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Pandraah foot lamba... Iska ek strike mujhe pahaad ki tarah crush kar dega!

panels.shot: centurion locking gaze on hajun ring
panels.action: The Centurion's azure eye-flames flicker as he notices the obsidian Ring of Hollow Blood on Ha-Jun's finger.
The giant raises his bone broadsword high overhead with both skeletal hands, aura blasting outward.

dialogue.speaker: centurion
dialogue.text: PROVE THY BLOOD, MORTAL WHELP! OR BECOME DUST UPON THIS FLOOR!

panels.shot: ha-jun summoning blood blade with furious gaze
panels.action: Ha-Jun draws his palm across his ring; The Sanguine Fang crystallizes in blazing crimson: 'Try me.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aao phir... Dekhte hain tumhari talwar tez hai ya mera khoon!
